location_exception_reason: PUF cabins are manufactured prefabricated structures with standardised specifications (panel thickness, thermal conductivity, frame design); origin location does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision criteria. Buyers select based on cabin type (office/security/accommodation), dimensions, insulation value, and delivery capability — not geographic origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in PUF cabin titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title like 'PUF Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product definition complete ('PUF Cabin'). The business relationship does not change what is being sold.
